messages:
maya: kicked off a cross-family GPTQ bakeoff today. compared GPTQ-4, AWQ-4, INT8, and experimental FP8 against fp16 baseline. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/bakeoffs/1752056789/

alex: nice — which eval suites?

maya: MMLU, LAMBADA (exact), WikiText perplexity, our code-completion bench, and a compact safety subset. perf trace = prod-like (median seq ~78).

eval-bot: bakeoff run complete — id: bakeoff-1752056789 — results uploaded.

maya: high-level TL;DR (MMLU delta vs fp16):
- Llama2-13B: AWQ -1.2%, GPTQ -2.9%, INT8 -4.1%, FP8 -1.0%.
- Mistral-7B: AWQ -3.1%, GPTQ -5.0%, INT8 -7.0%, FP8 -3.2%.
- Qwen-7B: AWQ -0.8%, GPTQ -2.3%, INT8 -5.3%, FP8 -0.6%.

jo: throughput and peak mem?

maya: microbench on A100/A80 class (single GPU):
- Llama2-13B fp16: 360 tok/s, peak 25GB. GPTQ: 450 tok/s (+25%), peak 10.2GB (-59%). AWQ: 430 tok/s, 11.0GB. FP8: 500 tok/s (+39%), 8.9GB (experimental runtime).
- Mistral-7B fp16: 540 tok/s, peak 15GB. GPTQ: 650 tok/s (+20%), 6.6GB (-56%). AWQ: 600 tok/s, 7.1GB.
- Qwen-7B fp16: 490 tok/s, peak 15.5GB. AWQ: 640 tok/s (+31%), 7.4GB. FP8: 670 tok/s stable in our run.

ram: cold-start and tail latencies?

maya: cold-first-token overhead +10–15ms for GPTQ/AWQ due to dequant overhead; steady-state tail improves under high concurrency since smaller memory allows better batching and more pre-warmed KV caches per GPU.

priya: safety/regression signals?

maya: safety subset: Mistral GPTQ shows a small but notable spike in hallucination/unsafe acceptance on some long-code pivots (~+4% FPR vs fp16). AWQ reduces that to ~+1%.

jo: any obvious failure modes?

maya: yes — attention-projection quantization in mid-blocks (blocks 8–12) for Mistral GPTQ correlated with token-repetition and wrong-token insertions in long-context code completions. reproducible on a small set. mitigation: keep those blocks in fp16 or use AWQ fallback.

maya: LAMBADA exact-match deltas vs fp16:
- Llama2-13B: AWQ -1.3 pts, GPTQ -3.2 pts, INT8 -5.0 pts, FP8 -1.1 pts.
- Mistral-7B: AWQ -3.5 pts, GPTQ -5.9 pts, INT8 -9.5 pts, FP8 -3.0 pts.
- Qwen-7B: AWQ -0.9 pts, GPTQ -2.6 pts, INT8 -4.8 pts, FP8 -0.7 pts.

jo: did you try mixed-precision?

maya: yes — for Mistral we kept first 2 and last 2 layers fp16, quantized the rest with AWQ. this removed most hallucination cases and retained ~50% GPU mem reduction.

maya: recommended deployment profiles (short):
- latency-sensitive (p95 SLA <150ms): AWQ or FP8 (if runtime certified); Dedicated pools with 20% memory headroom and small-batch bypass.
- throughput-first (batch-heavy): GPTQ with aggressive batching and pre-warmed KV-caches on Dedicated.
- constrained budget: AWQ hybrid or mixed-precision for best quality/memory tradeoff.

maya: AWQ sample config we used:
```json
{ "method": "AWQ", "block_size": 128, "per_channel": true, "fallback_blocks": [8,9,10,11,12], "calibration_samples": 4096 }
```

ram: can we add AWQ runtime to Dedicated quickstart and gate FP8 behind feature flag?

maya: please. @ram estimated ~2 sprints for image + validation.

priya: I'll add the failing Mistral code-completion prompts to the regression suite and create an eval alert for >3pt LAMBADA delta.

alex: can we get a one-pager for PMs summarizing tradeoffs?

alex: I'll draft today.

maya: action items: add AWQ runtime to Dedicated image (ram), add regression prompts and alert (priya), one-pager for PMs (alex).

maya: artifacts: per-prompt diffs and CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/bakeoffs/1752056789/results.csv.

maya: ping me if you want raw kernel traces or perf logs — I can share commands and profiler outputs.

sam: awesome work, Maya :rocket:

maya: thanks — closing thread; will reopen if we onboard new families.
